info.name: Buk Variables of the Empresas API

params.name: page_size
params.description: (OPTIONAL) Number of answers per page. By default, it has a value of 25 and must be within a range of [25 - 100].

params.name: empresa_id
params.description: ID of the Empresa of which you want to list its variables from Empresa

items.docs:
Displays all variables of the Empresas by Empresas registered in the system.

Este endpoint no requiere permisos especiales.
